video_title: Jalen Green Media Day 2026 Press Availability

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.text: I think just the pacing and just being able to read the game a little bit better. Hearing somebody who is caliber, you know, two-time MVP, Hall of Famer, being able to sit down and actually watch a workout and critique you as you go and that sticks with you. So just being able to hear him, how he breaks the game down, how he sees it helps a lot.
quotes.news_angle: Jalen Green credits working with a two-time MVP and Hall of Famer for his development.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Green says working with a two-time MVP and Hall of Famer this summer helped him improve his pacing and ability to read the game.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.text: He brings a lot of attention and I feel like I bring a lot of attention too. So, you know, that's going to open up a lot of lanes and creating good looks every time. But overall, just everybody moving together as one and you know, we understand what we need to do and I think the system that I brings is a really good system for the team that we have.
quotes.news_angle: Jalen Green expects his partnership with Devin Booker to create more scoring opportunities.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Green believes his partnership with Devin Booker will open up the floor and create better looks for the entire team.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Green
quotes.text: You seen a little bit of sheer last year. Just him coming in getting stops, him big shots. I mean, that's only going to get better. That's who he is as a player and I mean, I don't see anything else but him continuing to do that. And then adding a little bit more from the summer of just him being in the gym every day. I'll see him being in the gym in the morning and come back at night.
quotes.news_angle: Jalen Green praises his teammate for his work ethic and continued development.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Green says his teammate is putting in the work this summer, spending mornings and nights in the gym to take his game to the next level.
